author: Charles Kingsley
description: "Hypatia — or New Foes with an Old Face" by Charles Kingsley is a historical novel published in 1853.
longDescription: It follows Philammon, a young Egyptian monk who travels to Alexandria and becomes entangled in the violent religious and political conflicts of the fifth century.

authorInfo.bio: Charles Kingsley (1819–1875) wrote The Heroes; Or, Greek Fairy Tales for My Children. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
